title: LoRa L2: synchronize queue stats with queue destruction
description: Round-4 correctness review found lichen_lora_l2_queue_stats_get() can race lichen_lora_l2_deinit()/tx_queue_destroy(). The accessor permits non-UNINIT states and only takes the queue lock, while destroy requires exclusive quiescence; a state-only check has a TOCTOU window. Add lifecycle synchronization covering the public stats accessor and destruction, plus a regression.
